tasks.short: Plan brachytherapy treatment and calculate doses

steps.what: Verify the prescription, patient data and available planning inputs
Develop the brachytherapy plan and specify dose comparisons
Repeat specified calculation comparisons and assemble their result tables
Validate the complete plan and document dosimetric findings
Review and authorise the final treatment plan under local clinical arrangements
Release the exact authorised plan to the specified treatment workflow
Save the actual release reference in the planning record

tasks.design: Use only native repeat-calculation and table-assembly facilities in the commissioned treatment-planning environment represented by {OTHER}. Retain treatment choices and all clinical validation, and release only the exact final clinically authorised plan; no model calculates or selects clinical doses.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated comparison interactions and table assembly may remain manual around existing planning calculations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native validated planning-system batching and report templates, where already supported.
tasks.still_hard: Patient-specific geometry, clinical trade-offs and independent validation of the actual plan.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a mathematically consistent plan is clinically inappropriate.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated comparison interaction, with treatment responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: commissioned treatment-planning systems calculate specified doses; repeat-interaction automation requires local validation and does not replace clinical authorisation.

assumptions: Shares are provisional workflow proportions, not measured clinical time. Focal denominator is 92; all 8 oncologist points remain other-role work. Additional actual physics or clinical approval must be counted rather than assumed free.

The treating team supplies the authorised prescription and patient inputs; equipment custodians supply current commissioned data. s1 verifies identity, plan version and data provenance. Missing or inconsistent inputs stop automated comparison and require human resolution.

s2 produces exact candidate, comparison parameters and required outputs. Test native approved facilities first; s3 removes repeated manual interaction and table placement only, never existing dose-calculation runtime or independent validation.

s4 includes actual technical documentation. s5 authorises the final version and destination after it exists; changes return through validation and clinical authorisation. s7 is an ordinary small author save, retained without its own gate.
This graph does not administer treatment or propose a new clinical algorithm.
unknowns: Existing comparison automation and local commissioning requirements
Actual clinical and physics authorisation chain
research_questions: Which manual comparison interactions remain after existing planning runtime is excluded?

incremental.description: Maintain locally validated comparison mappings and regression checks

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact validated plan version, patient identity and treatment destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15/92 times 100=16.304 focal points, less 1 upkeep gives 15.304. With unusual source geometry requiring manual comparisons, only 3 workflow points of compatible table assembly disappear: 3/92 times 100 minus 1=2.261, conservatively 2.2. All clinical review and saves remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Measure radioactivity in patients or equipment

steps.what: Identify the subject and obtain actual radiation measurements with the monitoring device
Copy identified instrument readings into the clinical measurement record
Check identity, units and clinical meaning and save the actual measurement record

tasks.design: Test the native export/import route between the radiation-monitoring device and clinical record environment represented by {OTHER}. Transfer only exact identified readings into a draft record, retaining actual measurement, full clinical correspondence checks and the ordinary author save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Readings from an actual device may be manually copied into a separate record.
tasks.enabler_now: Validated instrument interfaces or structured imports where the existing device supports them.
tasks.still_hard: Reliable measurement conditions, correct subject association and interpreting unexpected readings.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an implausible reading or mismatch requiring a repeat measurement.
tasks.altitude: Less transcription, with measurement and interpretation unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: structured instrument interfaces can copy readings while subject identification and clinical interpretation remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares assume actual duplicate transcription from a device, not already automatic recording. Existing detector runtime earns no saving.

s1 includes subject identification, device association, actual measurement and capture of device identifier, timestamp, reading, units and subject reference. The existing device produces the export. Missing identity or unsupported readings require manual entry and checking, not inference.
Native validated interfaces are assessed first. s2 fills a draft only; s3 retains all clinical checks and final record writing. Its ordinary same-system save needs no author approval stage.
The task does not deliver radiation treatment or change device settings.
unknowns: Export capability of actual monitoring devices
Whether measurements already populate the record
research_questions: Can one real export preserve identity, timestamp and units exactly through the record import?

incremental.description: Maintain validated instrument mappings and identity checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15 transcription points less 1 upkeep gives 14. With mixed legacy meters, retain manual capture and checking for unsupported readings; only 3 points of structured digital copying are removed, giving 2 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Educate patients about treatment and aftercare

steps.what: Read the actual plan and find applicable approved patient information
Explain treatment, reactions and aftercare and capture actual patient questions
Write the actual patient education and follow-up record

loop.check: Dosimetrist verifies what was explained, patient questions, omissions and follow-up; no inferred consent or understanding
loop.stop: Missing facts or two failed drafts returns writing to the dosimetrist
loop.why_not_simpler: Native education form first; variable question narratives need limited restatement

steps.what: Check the complete education record and save it

tasks.design: Index approved information in {DOCS} by the actual treatment-plan reference, retaining full applicability reading and patient explanation. In the clinical record environment represented by {OTHER}, a bounded loop may restate the dosimetrist's captured education facts, followed by a complete human check and ordinary save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding approved information and restating actual discussion notes can be repetitive.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed guidance and locally permitted source-bound drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Patient anxiety, comprehension and recognising questions requiring the treating clinician.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt explanation to the patient and verify understanding through conversation.
tasks.altitude: Less navigation and limited restatement, with clinical responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: indexed approved information can reduce navigation; source-bound documentation drafting still requires complete clinical meaning checks.

assumptions: Provisional shares include actual patient education and its record, not a new mandatory report. No treatment plan or patient advice is generated.

The treating team produces the patient plan; guidance owners supply approved document identifiers and applicability tags. s1 verifies the match. s2 captures actual topics, questions and follow-up facts, with capture time retained.
Test native guidance filters and education forms first. Drafting uses only an approved clinical data route and counted notes, not a free transcript. Missing facts stay blank for manual completion.
Full reading, conversation, meaning review, final check and ordinary ungated save remain. A separate outbound aftercare message, if actually assigned, needs its own final-version check and send.
research_questions: Can the draft preserve actual education facts without inferring understanding or consent?

incremental.description: Maintain guidance tags and check documentation behaviour

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 1.5 navigation plus 1.5 restatement points=3, less 0.7 upkeep gives 2.3. For an unusual treatment plan and complex questions, retain most search and prose: only 0.5 navigation point and 0.5 factual-restatement point disappear, leaving 0.3 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain patient-specific planning, measurement interpretation and patient education while reducing verified transcription and repeated comparison interaction.
role.ambitious_version: Use verified recovered time for patient explanation and complete clinical checks, with no extension of treatment authority.
